experimental_blocks: hybrid: first convolution is regular padded 3x3; subsequent blocks use depthwise 3x3 then pointwise 1x1. Otherwise identical CNN normalization, activation, pooling and head. Not included in canonical tools.
factorized: each 3x3 convolution is replaced by a 3x1 convolution followed by a 1x3 convolution, without intermediate activation or normalization. Not included in canonical tools.
head_channels: biased 1x1 convolution after adaptive pooling and before flattening, without activation or normalization; 0 disables the block. Not included in canonical tools.

factorized: each 3x3 convolution is replaced by a 3x1 convolution followed by normalization and activation, then a 1x3 convolution followed by normalization and activation. Unlike factorized-spatial, intermediate normalization and activation are present. Not included in canonical tools.

recurrent: ordinary unshared 3x3 convolutions in the first stage. Each later stage projects channels with a biased 1x1 convolution plus normalization and activation, then applies one shared biased 3x3 convolution convs_per_stage times, with separate normalization and activation per application. Pooling follows each stage. Shared convolution parameters count once. Not included in canonical tools.

head_channels: biased 1x1 convolution after adaptive pooling and before flattening, followed by the selected normalization and activation; 0 disables the block. Unlike head-bottleneck, the projection includes normalization and nonlinearity. Not included in canonical tools.

biasfree: ordinary CNN architecture with convolution biases removed after initialization; classifier and normalization retain their biases. Initialization consumes the same random draws as the biased CNN. Not included in canonical tools.

recurrent: ordinary unshared 3x3 convolutions in the first stage. Each later stage projects channels with a biased 1x1 convolution plus normalization and activation, then applies one shared biased 3x3 convolution convs_per_stage times, with separate normalization and activation per application. Pooling follows each stage. Shared convolution parameters count once. Not included in canonical tools.

biasfree: ordinary CNN architecture with convolution biases removed after initialization; classifier and normalization retain their biases. Initialization consumes the same random draws as the biased CNN. Not included in canonical tools.

recurrent: ordinary first-stage convolutions; later stages use 1x1 projection, normalization and activation, then x=activation(x+norm(shared_conv(x))) for each repeated shared 3x3 convolution application. Normalization is separate per application. Residual additions introduce no parameters; initial tensors match recurrent-stage. Not included in canonical tools.
